recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic night scene featuring a large, glowing yellow full moon centered in a deep blue starry sky, with a small spider silhouetted against it. The bottom third shows a dark small-town skyline under a pink and orange sunset horizon, framed by dark, silhouetted foliage in the foreground corners.
coreVisualRelationships: The spider silhouette is perfectly centered within the circular moon for maximum contrast.
A thin vertical web line connects the top edge of the frame to the spider.
The warm horizon glow at the bottom balances the cool blue of the upper night sky.
Foreground tree silhouettes create a natural vignette that directs the eye to the central moon.
coreInvariants: Tri-color sky gradient (Blue to Pink to Orange)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The moon is the primary visual anchor, placed in the upper center; the spider is a micro-focal point within it.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow moon against the dark blue sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright moon, follows the vertical web line upward, then drops down to the horizon line and text area.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample dark blue sky provides a clean area for the central subject and upper-level credits.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep midnight blue for the upper sky and foreground silhouettes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright luminous yellow for the moon.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta and orange for the low-lying sunset clouds.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the moon and sky; high saturation in the sunset band.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to nocturnal blues and sunset warm tones

letterConstructionRules: Slightly condensed proportions for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a solid block of text

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the transition between blue sky and sunset clouds
placed against the pink sunset band

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching serif families with varying weights and scales to maintain a cohesive, classic cinematic look.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif structure of 90s thrillers.
Provides the elegant, sharp serifs seen in the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic night landscape. Top half is deep blue with stars and a large, glowing yellow full moon centered. A tiny black spider silhouette is in the center of the moon, hanging from a single vertical thread. Bottom third is a dark silhouette of a small town with houses and trees against a vibrant pink and orange sunset horizon. Frame the edges with dark silhouetted tree leaves.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large centered title in a bold, condensed yellow serif font with a subtle bevel effect. Below it, add a subtitle in a smaller, white serif font. Ensure both are centered horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the spider clearly visible against the moon?
Is the horizon gradient smooth from orange to blue?
Is the text centered and legible against the background colors?

adjustableVariables: Spider size relative to the moon
postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical alignment of the web line.
Verify the moon has a soft outer glow.
Ensure the town silhouette is dark enough to not distract from the moon.
Confirm the stars are subtle and not overwhelming.
Check that the title text has a slight metallic or beveled sheen.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central circular light source + silhouetted subject + tri-tone gradient sky + silhouetted base landscape base.
